newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-GRAMPUS BEATS JUBILO TO TAKE J.LEAGUE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GRAMPUS BEATS JUBILO TO TAKE J.LEAGUE LEAD.

text.p: Nagoya Grampus Eight returned to the top of the J.League table late on Wednesday when they crushed Jubilo Iwata 2-0, while their closest rivals Kashima Antlers suffered a defeat.
First-half goals by striker Shigeyoshi Mochizuki and French midfielder Franck Durix took Grampus back to the top of the standings for the first time since March 30.
They are four points ahead of second-placed Antlers with six games remaining.
Antlers lost to Kashiwa Reysol on Wednesday, with the only goal coming from striker Naoki Sakai in the 11th minute.
Verdy Kawasaki scored a victory over Yokohama Marinos 3-1 at Tokyo's National Stadium and Shimizu S-Pulse defeated Sanfrecce Hiroshima 3-2.
